title: A Wounded Fawn
description: A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.

title: The Unheard
description: After undergoing an experimental procedure to restore her damaged hearing, 20-year-old Chloe Grayden begins to suffer from auditory hallucinations seemingly related to the mysterious disappearance of her mother.

title: Nobody Gets Out Alive
description: Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.

title: The Pact
description: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

description: A woman plagued by nightmares of a serial killer learns her dreams have a horrifying connection to the real world.

title: Skeletons in the Closet
description: A woman becomes possessed by an evil spirit after she saves the life of her terminally ill daughter.

title: The Babadook
description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

title: Wildling
description: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events.

description: A disillusioned field surgeon who is suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder makes a man out of body parts and brings him to life in a Brooklyn loft.

description: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

title: Hatching
description: After finding a wounded bird, a girl brings its strange egg home and nurtures it until it hatches. The creature that emerges soon becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare, plunging her into a twisted reality that her mother refuses to see.

title: Deadsight
description: A pregnant police officer and a blind man fight for their lives against swarms of the living dead.

title: Extraterrestrial
description: Malevolent aliens interrupt five collegians' vacation at a remote woodland cabin.

title: Centigrade
description: A man and his pregnant wife become trapped in their car when a storm buries them underneath layers of snow and ice. As supplies dwindle and temperatures plunge, the couple must battle the elements and hypothermia in a desperate fight for survival.
